account.emailChangeSent: Check yer new inbox fer a confirmation link.
account.handleHint: Letters, digits, “_” an' “-”. Must be unique.

appearance.customColourHint: Pick any colour - buttons, highlights an' th' background tint follow it.

lastfm.desc: Scrobble yer plays t' Last.fm automatically.

data.body: Plunder everythin' Chordia stores about ye, or permanently scuttle yer account an' all its data.
data.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently scuttle yer account an' ALL yer data — listenin' history, charts, hoards, an' hearties? This cannot be undone.
data.deleteFailedBody: Could not scuttle yer account right now. Pray try again.
data.exportFailedBody: Could not export yer data right now. Pray try again.
data.title: Yer data

downloads.serverNote: Shanties hoards themselves be added an' organized on yer Chordia hoard server, not here. Stowin' booty t' a custom folder (wi' yer own path + organization layout) be comin' t' th' desktop app.

thisDevice.description: Plundered shanties be stored on this device an' play without a connection.
thisDevice.empty: Use th' Plunder action on any ditty or treasure.

downloads.title: Booty

autoplay.desc: Keep playin' similar shanties when th' muster ends.

crossfade.desc: Overlap an' blend th' end o' each ditty into th' next.

preload.desc: Plunder upcomin' muster ditties ahead o' time fer instant, gap-free playback. Higher uses more data.
preload.label: Preload next ditties

activityVisibility.desc: Who can see yer recent plays an' compare taste wi' ye.

emailNotifications.desc: Get an email fer matey requests an' other account activity.

scrobble.desc: Record what ye play fer yer stats an' Wrapped.

timezone.description: Used t' place listenin' activity on yer local calendar. Follow this device leaves th' choice t' each client.
timezone.noMatches: No time zones match yer hunt

sessions.body: Where ye be signed in. Revoke any device ye don't recognize.
sessions.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Sign out o' all devices? Ye'll need t' sign in again.

twoFactor.addHint: Add a second factor (an authenticator app) fer extra account security.
twoFactor.enabledHint: 2FA be enabled. T' turn it off, enter a current code or a recovery code.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: 2FA be on. Stow these recovery codes somewhere safe — each works once if ye lose yer authenticator.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan this wi' yer authenticator app, then enter th' 6-digit code t' confirm.

verifyEmail.body: We sent a verification link t' yer email. Didn't get it? Resend it below.
verifyEmail.title: Verify yer email
